name: Argelys Samuel Oriach | Performance Artist, Artistic Director & Systems Architect
description: Argelys Samuel Oriach is a Brooklyn-based performance artist, artistic director, and systems architect working across performance, design, and structural engineering. He constructs language for the room, page, stage, and screen. As founder and artistic director at Wild Lake Studio, he scouts and develops multidisciplinary artists whose practices, like his own, span multiple forms. His central offering to artists is his undivided attention.
